1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __with a first fore-aft rib and transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, __wherein said aero cover is integrally molded or adhesively bonded to said body panel__.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, __and said body panel is constructed from polypropylene reinforced with long glass fibers__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure, __wherein each said section of open rib structure is separated from adjacent closed ribs by a defined boundary__.

4. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure, __wherein said first and second aero covers are separately molded components__.

5. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, __and said transverse ribs are oriented perpendicular to said first fore-aft rib__.

6. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, __and said second plurality of transverse ribs are oriented perpendicular to said second fore-aft rib__.

7. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, __and said closed ribs are continuous and non-perforated__.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel, __wherein said fasteners are mechanical fasteners or adhesive bonds__.

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress, __wherein each buttress is reinforced by said open rib structure__.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress, __and said buttresses provide structural reinforcement at vehicle corners__.

11. (Original) The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa.

12. (Original) The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers.

13. (Original) The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm.

14. (Original) The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm.

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress, __wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib with transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides thereof, and said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib with transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides thereof__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, __wherein said aero covers are separately molded and secured to said body panel by fasteners__.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners, __wherein said first and second sections are molded separately and then assembled__.

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section, __and each buttress is positioned at a forward corner of the belly pan__.

18. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, __and said transverse ribs are oriented perpendicular to said first fore-aft rib__.

19. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, __and said second plurality of transverse ribs are oriented perpendicular to said second fore-aft rib__.

20. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, __and said closed ribs are continuous structural elements__.
